description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkConfigParsing component, which handles parsing and validation of talk configuration data such as provider selection and silence timeout settings.

classes.name: TalkConfigParsingTests
classes.description: A suite of test cases validating the behavior of talk configuration parsing, including provider selection and timeout handling.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedTalkProviderPayloadWithoutResolved
methods.description: Tests that a normalized talk provider payload without 'resolved' field is rejected.

methods.name: ignoresLegacyTalkFieldsWhenNormalizedPayloadMissing
methods.description: Ensures legacy talk fields are ignored when normalized payload lacks a 'resolved' field.

methods.name: readsConfiguredSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Validates that a specified 'silenceTimeoutMs' value in the configuration is correctly read.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenMissing
methods.description: Checks that the default silence timeout is used when the configuration is missing the 'silenceTimeoutMs' key.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenInvalid
methods.description: Ensures that an invalid 'silenceTimeoutMs' value results in falling back to the default.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenBool
methods.description: Verifies that a boolean 'silenceTimeoutMs' value defaults to the fallback timeout.
